Miami Nation of Indians of Indiana

The Miami Nation of Indians of Indiana is a Miami community organization headquartered in Peru, Indiana.

Selected reading

01

Community work in Peru

The community describes its work to preserve and share Miami history, language, culture, and heritage. Its land page describes the former high school as a center for community services and gatherings.
